ownShops.title: Own shops
ownShops.subtitle: The company's retail and wholesale shops, connected to the factory: one stock, shop billing and the day's cash
ownShops.noShops: No shop is set up yet
ownShops.noShopsAdmin: Add a branch of kind "shop" on Admin → Branches, then set it up on the Set-up tab.
ownShops.rateHelp: Leave the rate empty to use the shop's price list. Tax, MRP and stock are checked by the server.
ownShops.sold: Bill {{no}} posted and paid (receipt {{receipt}}). Stock left the shop place.
ownShops.counterRule: A counter sale is a tax invoice from the shop's GSTIN, takes stock out of the shop's place (never a batch on QC hold), and puts the money into the shop's cash or bank account. No cash receipt of ₹2 lakh or more from one person in a day.
ownShops.noOperate: You do not have the right to work the shop counter. Ask Admin.
ownShops.noBills: No counter bills on this date.
ownShops.closedOk: Day closed: the counted cash matches the cash the shop took.
ownShops.closedMismatch: Day closed with a difference. It goes to the Bug fixer for accounts.
ownShops.closeRule: At closing: bills = UPI + cash + card. The server works out the cash the shop took; any gap shows before the staff leave.
ownShops.noShopBranch: There is no branch of kind "shop" yet. Add it on Admin → Branches.
ownShops.gstTitle: GST between the factory and the shops

same.title: Same GSTIN, so not a sale.
same.body: Moving stock from the factory to a shop on the same registration is a transfer and goes on a delivery challan.

other.title: A different GSTIN, so a taxable supply.
other.body: Stock sent to another state's registration goes on a tax invoice with IGST and an e-way bill.

sales.title: Shop sales.
sales.body: Retail bills at MRP with GST included; wholesale invoices show the buyer's GSTIN. Every shop sale goes into that GSTIN's returns.

cash.title: Cash at the shops.
cash.body: The same cash limits apply at each counter: no receipt of ₹2 lakh or more from one person in a day.
